messages:
marta: Quick sketch — propose we decouple tenant routing from RBAC evaluation by delegating decisions to a lightweight auth-delegate service. Goal: reduce dashboard p95 on high-fanout queries by ~15–25% and make auth logic versionable and cacheable.

sam: Can you sketch the request flow and ownership? Who owns cache invalidation and policy updates?

marta: Flow (high level): edge -> router -> tenant-routing (cheap tag) -> consult auth-delegate -> route to query fanout. auth-delegate returns: {decision, cache_ttl, policy_hash, attributes}. Ownership: auth team owns delegate; console/router owns integration and local cache.

li: Concern: per-tenant overrides — e.g., admin revokes a permission, but cache still says allow. How do we avoid stale-allow windows?

marta: Two mitigations: short default TTL (30s) + versioned policy-hash header. On policy write we bump policy-hash; router sends x-policy-hash with requests; if mismatch, delegate treats as cache miss and returns authoritative decision. We also support a write-side invalidation hook to publish an invalidation event.

sam: Tokens question: today we rely on token->scopes mapping inside inline auth. Are we expecting a token exchange?

jena: Idea: router exchanges bearer for a short-lived signed 'router-assertion' minted by control-plane. Auth-delegate accepts either original bearer or internal assertion for internal calls. This avoids doing heavy introspection in delegate.

li: Latency: a remote auth call per request seems risky. What's the extra p50/p95 we expect?

marta: Design: 1) in-process fast-path for cached decisions (95% hit target), 2) async refresh for misses, 3) batch the decision call per root-request so a single call covers N fanout targets. SLA goal: <1ms p50 and <5ms p95 overhead for decision path (measured on our instance sizes).

jena: Audit/compliance: we need structured per-decision logs for some customers (audit-level). How are we exporting these?

marta: auth-delegate will emit structured audit events to Kafka. Sampling: 100% for admin-scoped decisions, 1% for regular reads by default. Router attaches trace id and tenant id for correlation.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI test-suite 'auth-delegate-integration' flaky in staging — policy reload sometimes blocks requests for ~500ms. https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98321 :warning:

sam: Ok, operationally we need a rollback and canary plan. Proposal: 10% tenants -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with metrics gate. Add a circuit-breaker fallback to legacy inline auth (fail-open=false; fail-closed-> fallback to offline check).

li: Edge case: tenant-scoped feature flags are used to pick projection materialization. If auth-delegate only says allow=true, we also need attributes shipped back so router can decide which materialization to hit.

marta: Agreed — delegate returns an attributes map (eg feature_grants, quota_class) used by the router to make routing decisions and to tag requests.

jena: Dedicated/private customers: they may not want a shared multi-tenant auth-delegate.

marta: We'll support two modes: 1) shared multi-tenant auth-delegate with strict tenancy isolation and audited separation, 2) per-customer auth-delegate deployed in Dedicated VPCs (customer profile controls mode).

sam: Security: what about service-to-service auth and replay protections for router-assertion?

marta: router-assertion is short-lived (30s), signed with control-plane key, includes nonce+audit id. Delegate verifies signature and nonce. We will log token-less route for quick-path metrics.

marta: Draft API sketch (will include in RFC):
```
POST /v1/decide
Headers:
  x-tenant-id: t-123
  Authorization: Bearer <router-assertion>
  x-policy-hash: v2-abcdef
Body:
  {"resource":"dashboard.view","action":"read","context":{}}
Response:
  {"decision":"allow","cache_ttl":30,"policy_hash":"v2-abcdef","attributes":{"feature_grants":["new-proj"]}}
```

jena: Nice. What perf tests do we need before canary?

marta: Perf plan: synthetic p95 under realistic fanout (N=20), cache-hit vs miss, policy-reload storm test, and a resilience test where delegate is delayed -> validate circuit-breaker and fallback path.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging run 98321 attached logs (policy-reload race) — @marta @sam assign to triage.

sam: Next steps: write lightweight RFC with API spec + perf targets + rollout canary + telemetry plan. Include a migration adaptor to gradually switch routes. Also add a feature flag to enable per-tenant batching.

marta: I'll draft the RFC and a stub API server (mock) for integration tests. Target: RFC draft by EOD Friday. Ping me if you want to pair on the mock. :smile:

li: Thanks — will add a checklist for token exchange and invalidation hooks.

jena: I'll coordinate audit requirements with compliance and add desired retention and export formats.

marta: Thanks all.
